content.description:
Who We Are & Why Join Us

Avathon is the leading Industrial AI autonomy platform, helping customers across heavy industries -- energy, mining, manufacturing, aerospace, defense, and logistics -- accelerate the journey toward autonomous operations. Our platform is built on a Computational Knowledge Graph foundation that contextualizes and connects operational data across siloed systems, bringing together time series, structured, unstructured, and machine vision data to power AI-driven applications in asset performance management, supply chain intelligence, visual AI, and global trade management. With capabilities spanning digital twins, normal behavior modeling, natural language processing, and computer vision, Avathon delivers real-time predictive intelligence and agentic decision-making at industrial scale.

Cutting-Edge AI Innovation -- Join a team at the forefront of AI, developing groundbreaking solutions that shape the future. High-Growth Environment -- Thrive in a fast-scaling startup where agility, collaboration, and rapid professional growth are the norm. Meaningful Impact -- Work on AI-driven projects that drive real change across industries and improve lives.

Learn more at: avathon.com

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the Avathon platform: the layers every one of our applications is built on. That includes data ingestion and connectors for IT and OT systems, the ontology and Computational Knowledge Graph, the Model Hub for ML and LLM models, and the agentic AI layer. Today platform priorities are set reactively, by whatever the next deployment needs. Your job is to make the platform a product, with a clear roadmap for connectors, ontology, models and agents, so that applications and customers can build on it with less custom work. This is a product management role in Product Engineering, not a customer delivery role.

You Will

Product Strategy and Roadmap

Own the vision, roadmap and priorities for ingestion and connectors, ontology and knowledge graph, Model Hub and the agent layer

Know the market. Understand Palantir Foundry and AIP, C3 AI, Databricks, Cognite and the hyperscaler AI platforms, and be clear on where Avathon wins in industrial settings

Own connector prioritization across OT protocols (OPC-UA, DNP3, MQTT, historians) and IT systems (SAP, Oracle and others)

Define the platform contracts that Planning, Logistics, PLM, asset performance and vision applications build on

Customer and Internal Discovery

Treat application teams, forward deployed engineers and partners as platform customers and understand what slows them down

Work with customers on ontology discovery and on how their data should be modeled

Work with security and cloud operations on deployment models: SaaS, customer cloud, on-premise and air-gapped edge

Track platform adoption and value, such as time to first data, connector reuse and time to deploy a model

Execution

Write clear requirements and acceptance criteria for platform engineering and AI science

Run sprint planning and release reviews with the engineering lead

Make trade-offs between platform investment and near-term customer needs, and communicate them clearly

Build developer documentation, release notes and enablement for internal teams and partners

You'll Have

8+ years in product management, with at least 4 years owning a data, ML, developer or platform product

Experience at Palantir, C3 AI, Databricks, Snowflake, Cognite, or a hyperscaler AI or data platform team (Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft) is a strong plus

Deep understanding of data integration, data modeling and ontologies, and ML or LLM operations

Exposure to industrial data (OT systems, historians, SCADA, ERP) is a strong plus

Technical enough to go deep with platform engineers on APIs, data models and architecture

Strong written communication. You can explain a platform decision to an engineer and to a customer executive

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. MS or MBA is a plus

Compensation

Pay Range: $140k - $180k salary annually. Pay for this position is based on a number of factors including geographic location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Location: This role is not remote. Candidates must be based in the Bay Area, CA and are expected to report to our Pleasanton office 5 days a week.

Avathon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Avathon is committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us to discuss how we can assist you.
